item.text: I’ll first inspect the existing workspace to see whether there’s an app scaffold to build on, then I’ll implement the registration experience in its current structure.

The workspace is empty, so I’m creating a self-contained vanilla HTML/CSS/JS app. I’ll make the four sections navigable without reloads, with accessible search and filters, registration validation, and a keyboard-friendly confirmation dialog.

Created the responsive course registration app in [index.html](/work/index.html), [styles.css](/work/styles.css), and [app.js](/work/app.js).

It includes Home, Course Catalog, Registration, and Profile sections; searchable and filterable course cards; a registration form with accessible validation; a confirmation dialog; and a registered-courses table with credit totals. The layout adapts for mobile and includes semantic structure, labeled controls, keyboard focus indicators, and screen-reader announcements.

I didn’t run tests.
